title: T1528 — Steal Application Access Token
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Steal Application Access Token with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker phishes an OAuth consent, steals an access token, replays it against the cloud, exfiltrates data, and is stopped by the SOC

steps.title: Identify the application
steps.caption: The attacker finds a SaaS or cloud app whose token grants useful access.
steps.defender: Application access and consent events are logged by the IdP.

fields.detail: The attacker finds a SaaS or cloud app whose token grants useful access.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Steal the token
steps.caption: A token is copied from browser storage, logs, or a compromised endpoint.
steps.defender: Token theft may leave no authentication event at all.

fields.detail: A token is copied from browser storage, logs, or a compromised endpoint.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Replay the token
steps.caption: The attacker uses the bearer token from a different location.
steps.defender: Impossible-travel and new user-agent signals appear.

fields.detail: The attacker uses the bearer token from a different location.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Enumerate access
steps.caption: The token is used to list resources and permissions.
steps.defender: A burst of API reads follows a token use from a new source.

fields.detail: The token is used to list resources and permissions.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Access data
steps.caption: The attacker reads mail, files, or CRM records.
steps.defender: SaaS audit logs record the actual data access.

fields.detail: The attacker reads mail, files, or CRM records.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Establish persistence
steps.caption: The attacker creates a new token or grants consent.
steps.defender: New consent grants and token issuance are durable evidence.

fields.detail: The attacker creates a new token or grants consent.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Exfiltrate
steps.caption: Data is exported through the application API.
steps.defender: Mass export and unusual download volume are detectable.

fields.detail: Data is exported through the application API.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: SOC revokes
steps.caption: The SOC revokes sessions, rotates secrets, and reviews consent.
steps.defender: Containment requires revoking tokens, not just passwords.

fields.detail: The SOC revokes sessions, rotates secrets, and reviews consent.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
